name: Policy and strategy
definition: National or local policy, strategy and target setting for the function.
public_definition: National or local policy, strategy and target setting for the function.

name: Network and investment planning
definition: Identifying needs and candidate schemes; network plans and prioritised programmes, including an outline delivery plan prepared by a partner (B3) and the Schedule of MD Works.
public_definition: Identifying needs and candidate schemes; network plans and prioritised programmes, including an outline delivery plan prepared by a partner (B3) and the Schedule of MD Works.

name: Allocation to project
definition: Allocating funding to a project or service within an activity, with the allocating body Accountable. Programme envelopes, terms and conditions sit in X-17 (Decision 2).
public_definition: Allocating funding to a project or service within an activity, with the allocating body Accountable. Programme envelopes, terms and conditions sit in X-17.

name: Sponsorship and funding application
definition: Preparing and submitting a bid or business case as Sponsoring Agency; accepting allocations and their conditions.
public_definition: Preparing and submitting a bid or business case as Sponsoring Agency; accepting allocations and their conditions.

name: Appraisal and design
definition: Feasibility, options, preliminary and detailed design, non-statutory consultation and business-case preparation by the sponsor. Excludes the approval decision (S5G).
public_definition: Feasibility, options, preliminary and detailed design, non-statutory consultation and business-case preparation by the sponsor. Excludes the approval decision (S5G).

name: Gateway and acceptance decision
definition: A decision by a funder, Approving Authority, asset owner or consenting body that allows progression or accepts something: NTA/TII gateways, design departures, acceptance of works for taking in charge, discharge of planning conditions, and **prior statutory consents by another body** (e.g. TII consent under s.38(5) RTA 1994 or s.9(7) RTA 2004) (B9).
public_definition: A decision by a funder, Approving Authority, asset owner or consenting body that allows progression or accepts something: NTA/TII gateways, design departures, acceptance of works for taking in charge, discharge of planning conditions, and **prior statutory consents by another body** (e.g. TII consent under s.38(5) RTA 1994 or s.9(7) RTA 2004) (B9).

name: Environmental assessment, screening and exemption check
definition: EIA and AA screening and, where required, full assessment; publication of determinations. **Records the exemption basis** where no consent is needed (s.4(1)(e)/(g) PDA 2000; s.152 PDA 2024) and the check that it is not lost under s.4(4). Replaces the dropped S7d.
public_name: Environmental assessment, screening and exemption check
public_definition: EIA and AA screening and, where required, full assessment; publication of determinations. **Records the exemption basis** where no consent is needed (s.4(1)(e)/(g) PDA 2000; s.152 PDA 2024) and the check that it is not lost under s.4(4). Replaces the dropped S7d.

name: Statutory consent: LA development
definition: The LA's own development consented by Part 8 (s.179 PDA 2000 until 25 Nov 2026; s.159 PDA 2024 from 26 Nov 2026). Reserved: elected members.
public_definition: The LA's own development consented by Part 8 (s.179 PDA 2000 until 25 Nov 2026; s.159 PDA 2024 from 26 Nov 2026). Reserved: elected members.

name: Statutory consent: road traffic works
definition: Works by the road authority under s.38 RTA 1994 (standard Traffic Works Order or trial), with Garda consultation and public notice. Executive. Only for activities on public road space.
public_definition: Works by the road authority under s.38 RTA 1994 (standard Traffic Works Order or trial), with Garda consultation and public notice. Executive. Only for activities on public road space.

name: Statutory consent: application or appeal to ACP
definition: Applications to An Coimisiún Pleanála (e.g. s.177AE or s.175 PDA 2000, s.51 Roads Act 1993) and **CPO confirmation** (B1).
public_name: Statutory consent: application or appeal to ACP
public_definition: Applications to An Coimisiún Pleanála (e.g. s.177AE or s.175 PDA 2000, s.51 Roads Act 1993) and **CPO confirmation** (B1).

name: Statutory determination
definition: A decision by a public body that fixes the legal status of land or an asset (declaring a road public; extinguishing a public right of way) or decides whether another party's development may proceed (planning permission, appeal, material contravention resolution). Excludes consent for the sponsor's own works (S7a–c), rules and licences governing use (S13a/b) and acceptance or discharge decisions (S5G). **Tie-break:** a decision that creates an offence for users of the asset is S13a/b. New in v0.4 (Decision 9).
public_definition: A decision by a public body that fixes the legal status of land or an asset (declaring a road public; extinguishing a public right of way) or decides whether another party's development may proceed (planning permission, appeal, material contravention resolution). Excludes consent for the sponsor's own works (S7a–c), rules and licences governing use (S13a/b) and acceptance or discharge decisions (S5G). **Tie-break:** a decision that creates an offence for users of the asset is S13a/b.

name: Land and rights acquisition
definition: The acquiring authority's actions: voluntary agreements, making a CPO, wayleaves and access licences. CPO confirmation is S7c (B1).
public_definition: The acquiring authority's actions: voluntary agreements, making a CPO, wayleaves and access licences. CPO confirmation is S7c (B1).

name: Procurement and contract award
definition: Procurement of consultants, contractors, operators and suppliers; frameworks; concession contracts; contract award.
public_definition: Procurement of consultants, contractors, operators and suppliers; frameworks; concession contracts; contract award.

name: Construction and implementation
definition: Delivery of works or implementation of measures, including site supervision, client duties and handover.
public_definition: Delivery of works or implementation of measures, including site supervision, client duties and handover.

name: Operation and service management
definition: Day-to-day operation of an asset or service, including co-ordination of works by others and temporary traffic management.
public_definition: Day-to-day operation of an asset or service, including co-ordination of works by others and temporary traffic management.

name: Maintenance and renewal
definition: Routine, reactive, winter and periodic maintenance, and like-for-like renewal of an existing asset, including its funding source. A funded upgrade or layout change is a new S3–S10 cycle (B10).
public_definition: Routine, reactive, winter and periodic maintenance, and like-for-like renewal of an existing asset, including its funding source. A funded upgrade or layout change is a new S3–S10 cycle (B10).

name: Rules and bye-laws
definition: Making rules that govern use of an asset or service: bye-laws, special speed limits, default limits, standards, fare rules.
public_definition: Making rules that govern use of an asset or service: bye-laws, special speed limits, default limits, standards, fare rules.

name: Licences, permits and orders
definition: Individual decisions under those rules or under statute: licences, permits, approvals of locations, closure orders and road works speed limit orders.
public_definition: Individual decisions under those rules or under statute: licences, permits, approvals of locations, closure orders and road works speed limit orders.

name: Enforcement
definition: Enforcing rules, licences and orders: offences, fixed payment notices, compliance inspection, T5 acceptance and cost recovery (B7, B8).
public_definition: Enforcing rules, licences and orders: offences, fixed payment notices, compliance inspection, T5 acceptance and cost recovery (B7, B8).

name: Monitoring, close-out and reporting
definition: Project close-out and review, funder close-out acceptance and verification (B4), grant reporting, performance monitoring and evaluation.
public_definition: Project close-out and review, funder close-out acceptance and verification (B4), grant reporting, performance monitoring and evaluation.
